purpose: Freezes idle app backends and (for powos-sleep-gui) unfocused GUI apps with the cgroup v2 freezer; thaws them on a connection, focus, D-Bus or `powos sleep wake`.
cgroups: /sys/fs/cgroup/powos/sleep/<thing> (one per frozen thing, removed on thaw)
remove: kill $(cat /run/powos-sleep/sleepd.pid) (thaws everything); rm -rf /usr/lib/powos/apps/powos-sleep* /usr/bin/powos-sleepd /run/powos-sleep /var/lib/powos/sleep; rmdir /dev/memcg/powos/sleepd /dev/cpuctl/powos/sleepd /sys/fs/cgroup/powos/sleepd; drop the powos-sleepd lines from powos-start.sh
